entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is 775-B-119.
Certainly. Let me pull that up for you. One moment... Okay, I see the AeroLite helmet. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet?
There's no issue. I just don't want it. The color isn't what I expected. Can I return it or not?
I understand. I just need to confirm a few details. I see the order was delivered 73 days ago. Is the item still in its original condition?
Yes, it's still in the box unopened. I never even took it out. Your policy is 10 days, so this should be simple.
You are absolutely correct. You're well within the return window. I can process that for you right now. Getting the right gear is essential for safety, and that includes a color you're happy with.
Great. So you're sending the label?

Yes. I've just initiated the return, and the shipping label is on its way to your email. As you're a VIP member with us, I've also included a complimentary express shipping voucher for your next order. We want to make sure you get the gear you want as quickly as possible.
Okay. I've got the email. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
